13:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: The Pat McAfee Show
Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor; he and his cast of characters unpack the day's top stories and interview the biggest names in sports.

15:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The Rutgers Scarlet Knights (3-0) face the No. 8 Houston Cougars (3-0) at Michelob Ultra Arena. Both enter undefeated, with Rutgers beating Bryant 72-51 behind Christian Gurdak and Houston topping Jacksonville State 92-46 behind Dedan Thomas Jr.
